privacy: No keys, vault ciphertext, post text, author names, post hashes, full URLs, custom rule text or browser history included.

risk.label: Risk or scam-like content
risk.description: Solicitations for money, credentials, wallet secrets or trades that lean on urgency and unlikely returns. Collapsed by default.

feedSpam.label: Feed spam
feedSpam.description: Repetitive, mass-solicitation or copy-paste patterns with no information value. Collapsed at high confidence; conflicts with useful content are dimmed.

unwantedAd.label: Unwanted advertising
unwantedAd.description: Unsolicited low-value promotion: a sales push with nothing readers can use, no original work and no first-hand result. Promotion alone never triggers this category.

bait.label: Manipulative engagement bait
bait.description: Vague hooks, emotional prompts and follower farming with no substance. Dimmed for review, never hidden at high useful-content signal.

lowSignal.label: Low-signal filler
lowSignal.description: Platitudes, filler and recycled framing with almost no information. Off by default; enable to dim it.

custom.label: Your exclusion rule
custom.description: A single plain-language criterion you write yourself. Off unless you enable it.
